Design, estimation, inference, comparison, and regression.

This course expects complete reasoning: definitions and hypotheses are stated,
manual arguments remain visible, computation is labeled as exact or approximate,
and conclusions are interpreted rather than merely reported.

## Course outcomes

- Connect study design and sampling mechanisms to valid statistical conclusions.
- Quantify uncertainty using sampling distributions, intervals, and tests.
- Check assumptions and distinguish statistical from practical significance.
- Fit, diagnose, and interpret foundational statistical models reproducibly.

## Prerequisites

probability, mathematical-computing
